name: raven-eval
description: Versioned benchmark for Raven: graph accuracy, readiness findings, change impact, retrieval and grounded Q&A, with hand-labelled ground truth. Bump the version whenever a label or a source file changes.

repos.description: Synthetic FastAPI shop service written for this benchmark: nested router prefixes, SQLAlchemy + pydantic models, auth dependency, and one deliberate instance of each labelled readiness pattern.
Synthetic, deliberately well-behaved FastAPI service: false-positive checks for readiness rules and abstention.
Real public repository (backend/ subset, vendored byte-identical, MIT): 23 routes behind a dynamic prefix, SQLModel tables, JWT auth in a file that uses Python 3.14-only syntax.
